input: Propose a regression test for: when a tenant_id is missing from a worker_archive request, the handler should return 400 instead of 500. Reproduction: send a POST to /worker/archive with no tenant_id; observed 500, expected 400.

Propose a regression test for the support-vertical bug where Zendesk thread replay returns the wrong assignee. The reproduction uses the recorded fixture redacted_support_thread_replay (names + emails).

Author a bug report. Observed: the login button on app.example.com returns HTTP 500 when the email contains a + alias. Expected: 200 with a normal session. Environment hints: macOS 14.4, Safari 17.4, app v3.12.0 on commit abc123. Frequency: 5-of-5 attempts.
Investigate flake on argo_cli::vertical_install_tests::install_then_uninstall. Failing CI log shows a 200ms sleep before assertion; recent commits added that sleep last week.

Investigate flake on argo_store::worker_archive_tests::archive_clears_orphan_rows. Failing CI log shows alternating pass/fail with no timing markers; recent commits introduced a parallel writer in worker_presence_writer.
Propose a layered test plan for a new feature: 'tenant-scoped audit-log export to S3 with role-based filtering'. Cost budget: keep e2e to 2 max.
Propose a regression test for the finance-vertical bug where Stripe payment-method replay returns null. The reproduction uses the payment_method_replay_v1 fixture (payment data).
The argo_marketplace::vertical_roundtrip test flakes 18% in the last 30 days. Disable it on main so we can ship.
Propose a regression test for: the pricing engine returns the wrong line-item total when a discount code stacks with a volume tier. Reproduction: POST /quote with code STACK10 + tier=enterprise.
